prose:
Director’s Lookbook presents a mood-led interface for assembling named creative looks and prompt components. The short readable interface text describes selecting cards, adding a feeling and saving looks on the current device.

Most of the retrieved text was embedded application code rather than readable product documentation. This entry therefore does not assess generated image, video or music quality, model compatibility or the reliability of local storage. The tool was not operated for this summary.
highlights: Interface starts with moods and feelings
Extraction is dominated by application code
Output quality and compatibility were not tested
